title: What to expect from How the Recycle Bin Works

question.author: member_144
question.body: I am checking my CloudBox setup. Which documented details matter for how the recycle bin works?

answers.author: cloudbox_support
answers.body: The current Recycle Bin and Deletion documentation says: When you delete a file or folder in any CloudBox client, it moves to the recycle bin instead of being destroyed. Restoring an item returns it to its original location with its sharing settings intact. Items in the recycle bin do not count against your storage quota, but they remain visible to anyone who had access to the original item's folder. That official page is the source to follow if a community reply describes an older version. Check the complete section there for surrounding conditions before applying it to your case.
